```{r data generation, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
options(scipen=99)
ndig = sample(4:5,1)
digs = sample(1:9,ndig)

exponents = c("⁰","¹","²","³","⁴","⁵","⁶","⁷","⁸","⁹")
cdot = "·"

tot = sum(digs*10^((ndig-1):0))
ss = paste0(digs,cdot,"10",exponents[ndig:1],collapse=" + ")
ss2 = paste0(digs,cdot,10^((ndig-1):0),collapse=" + ")
ss3 = paste0(digs*10^((ndig-1):0),collapse=" + ")


```

Question
========

Evaluate the expression: 

`r ss`


Solution
========

This is easier than it looks.

`r ss`

`r ss2`

`r ss3`

`r tot`
